_comment: Riptide's 'whenever you play a card from hand, you may put a card from hand face down into your arsenal' is NOT implemented. It was authored as PUT_CARDS_BOTTOM, which bottom-decks every card in hand and reads none of amount/face_down/destination -- so it would have destroyed the player's hand on every card played. Removed rather than approximated; there is no hand-to-arsenal effect yet. The second ability's trigger, ON_TRAP_TRIGGER, is not a trigger name at all and is still dead; the audit reports it.
